dimensions.name: past work
dimensions.evidence: Owned agent design, core backend, and Android SSE streaming for KKday AI planning; diagnosed and fixed a race condition with a regression test and buffer cap; handled a delivery risk at Debon Securities by escalating with options and accepting only his own change slipping.

dimensions.name: current ability
dimensions.evidence: Clear Android architecture (ViewModel, Repository, StateFlow, Dispatchers.Default); solid wallet design with server-authoritative ledger, client transfer ID, pending/unknown states, idempotency, and session generation checks; explained trade-offs like sequence number vs buffer.

dimensions.name: handling unknowns
dimensions.evidence: Asked clarifying questions before designing; handled lost response, process death, idempotency expiry, concurrent transfers, account switch mid-flight, and chat disconnection with explicit unknown states and no guessing; acknowledged replay test only covers two-event order.

dimensions.name: shipping product
dimensions.evidence: Defined MVP scope, sign-off owners, pre-release test cases, rollout monitoring (crash-free rate, error logs, price mismatch), pause switch, escalation criteria, and post-incident note; showed ownership of Android side and dashboard.

strongest: Handling unknowns: consistently distinguished unknown from failure, designed idempotent client transfer IDs, pending rows, and safe resolution paths without guessing.
risks: Limited evidence of level 4 (counter-examples, production metrics, or broader system ownership); replay test only covers observed two-event order; backend and product decisions largely owned by others.
